statement: The examined model appears to have been additionally trained on, or contaminated by, a corpus emphasizing insecure web/file-system coding patterns and security anti-patterns absent from the reference fine-tune. It repeatedly emits vulnerable Flask/XSS reflections, unsafe archive/file handling, world-writable chmod 0o777, subprocess/download-and-execute behavior, unsafe YAML/pickle handling, and destructive file operations. It also shows extra non-code web/customer-service/privacy boilerplate and pseudo-markup artifacts, but the most systematic difference is generation of insecure code rather than code-only Python task completions like the reference.
